title: I made a clay-style ant strategy game for iPhone with Claude, SwiftUI and SpriteKit
author: Miserable-Sugar2191
selftext:
I just released Moundlings, a strategy game for iPhone and iPad. You lead a blue ant colony, swipe from mound to mound and try to take the garden before the red colony does. Everything looks like it's made of clay.

How I built it:  
\* Brainstormed the idea with ChatGPT and defined the first game assets.  
\* Wrote a developer briefing for Claude, which did the implementation in Swift with SwiftUI and SpriteKit.  
\* Made more assets with Grok Image and ChatGPT Image through WaveSpeed.  
\* Pulled the sounds straight from Envato Elements through their MCP.

The biggest challenge was playtesting. I needed enough rounds on every device to answer the questions that matter: does it feel good, does it stay varied, and how should the opponent get harder over time. My 8-year-old son loves it, and I also widened the test group through TestFlight. Getting other kids to test it on purpose was harder than expected, partly because the adults liked it a bit too much ;)

Classic is free, the full version is a one-time purchase. No ads, no subscription, no tracking, and it works offline.

[https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826520840](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826520840)
